**PR #227 open + green: transitional records-aware memory-gate (unblocks cutover #225)**

What: Shipped the express micro-slice fixing cutover blocker finding #9. PR #227 (branch fix/issue-226-memory-gate-records-aware → feature/v2.0.0, Part of #226, type:bug, issue #226 status:approved), commit e2b593f, all REQUIRED gates GREEN (memory-gate pass, brain-writes-reviewed pass, decision-gate/diff-size/issue-link/local-checks/phase-order pass). actor-check fail is the expected solo-maintainer L5 DETECTION (not a merge gate).

Why: Post engram chunks→records cutover, the governance memory-gate failed by construction — run-check.mjs read session_summary ONLY from .memory/chunks/*.jsonl.gz (readChunkObservations), which the cutover empties; the summaries now live in .memory/records/*.jsonl. Verified against the real store (read-only): 47 chunk files, gate blind to records/.

The fix (transitional; chunks-path retirement is C4/D1):
- store.mjs: new best-effort readRecordObservations({recordsDir}) — full records incl .type, never-throws (readFileSync wrapped in try/continue too — hardened in review over the sub-agent's first pass), reuses readRecordIds's per-line JSON.parse idiom (no second parser).
- run-check.mjs: memory-gate = memoryPresence(readChunks(cwd).concat(readRecords(cwd))) — records/ OR chunks/; readRecords injectable dep.
- governance.yml: comment-only, reflects transitional world.
- Strict TDD: 3 gate cases (only records / only chunks / neither→fail) + reader unit. npm test 1049 pass 0 fail. No brain/core/ touched.

Caveat: PR #227's own branch is pre-cutover (off feature/v2.0.0), so its memory-gate passes via the CHUNKS path — records/ not materialized there. The records path is validated by tests; it gets exercised for real when #225 does Update branch.

Where: brain/scripts/memory/lib/store.mjs, brain/scripts/governance/run-check.mjs (+ .test.mjs each), .github/workflows/governance.yml.

Next: human PR-as-review of #227 → merge → Update branch on #225 (the cutover) → memory-gate re-runs GREEN on records → cutover merges WITHOUT bypass. Related open finding [[governance/skip-memory-gate-unwired]] (id 384, separate issue). Out of scope here: D1 per-issue session-record semantics.
